en: The image is a vintage-style green and tan stamp or cinderella label, not a postcard. It features a line drawing of a building with a tall spire, surrounded by ornate floral borders. The text includes the word 'ESTONUJO' (Estonia in Esperanto), 'TALLINN-LA URBODOMO' (Tallinn City Hall in Esperanto), and 'PER ESPERANTO NI INTERFATIĜAS' (Through Esperanto we communicate). Esperanto symbols and the Estonian national coat of arms are included.
